summary: Tested the proprietary cookie/consent manager end to end (backend pytest with 23 tests, plus Playwright on desktop 1920 and mobile 390 with a fresh browser context for each scenario). Almost every requested flow works. Two real issues: (1) PUT /api/platform/privacy/settings returns 500 instead of 400/422 when banner or category texts are too short or invalid. (2) After revoking analytics, a PostHog cookie (ph_<key>_posthog) is written again after the purge and is still present after the reload.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error when banner.it.text is shorter than 40 characters, or on any LangText/CatText validation failure. Cause: LangText(**...) and CatText(**...) are built by hand inside put_settings (privacy_consent.py lines 182-185). The pydantic ValidationError they raise is not converted into an HTTP error. Fix: wrap those lines in try/except ValidationError and raise HTTPException(400, a readable message), or declare banner/categories as typed models in SettingsIn. The UI currently shows a generic error toast.

minor.issue: CONSENT_ID_RE ^[a-f0-9-]{36}$ accepts 36 dashes (verified: 200) or any hex/dash mix. Parse with uuid.UUID(body.consent_id) instead.
The version number is built from the current date (YYYY.MM.n). Behaviour is correct (2026.10.1 -> .2 -> .3), but each month restarts at .1.

ui_bugs.issue: Revoking analytics from accept_all (footer dialog, both toggles off, Save): the page reloads, PostHog is not loaded and __crmTrackers are all 'blocked'. But document.cookie still contains ph_phc_..._posthog, and its $sesid timestamp is about 12ms after the save. So the running PostHog instance rewrites the cookie after purge() and before the reload finishes. Also, line 55 calls posthog.opt_out_capturing() only when marketing is revoked, but it should run when analytics is revoked. Fix: before purge, if analytics was revoked, call posthog.opt_out_capturing(), posthog.reset() and set_config({persistence:'memory'}). Also purge ph_/_ga cookies in the index.html bootstrap whenever stored choices.analytics is false.

issues: 'Personalizza' wraps onto its own row at full width (396px vs 194px for the other two buttons). Same styling, but it looks bigger. Consider a 3-column grid or stacking all three at equal width.
Logo in the banner is very small (h-6, about 48px wide).
The 'Versioni P/C/B' column is clipped at the right edge of the card on 1920px. The table needs overflow-x-auto or a smaller font.

passed_flows: First visit: banner shown. __crmTrackers all 'blocked', window.posthog undefined, window._iub undefined, no gtag/posthog/brevo network requests. dataLayer consent default has the four keys 'denied'.

Accept all: banner hides and POST /api/privacy/consents returns 200. localStorage choices analytics/marketing are true. posthog='loaded'; ga and brevo='allowed_host_skipped'. dataLayer consent update is 'granted'. After reload: no banner and trackers applied again.
Reject all: trackers stay blocked and false/false is stored. No banner after reload. /login and /registrati are usable with no tracker requests.
Customise with analytics only: posthog loaded, brevo blocked, payload action 'custom' and source 'preferences'. Toggles start unchecked.

Footer link footer-cookie-prefs opens the dialog showing the current choices (checked/checked). Switching analytics off reloads the page, PostHog is not loaded, and the registry stores event 'revoke' with revoked [analytics, marketing].
Language: IT and EN switch work and labels change. With the en-US browser locale the banner opens in English.
Banner appears on /login and in /app after a fresh login. The user menu item cookie-prefs-menu-link opens the dialog.
Consent saved after login stores user_id (user_9b3dabbcca7e). After logout and login again there is no duplicate banner.

Backend: config is public. Bad consent id returns 400 'ID consenso non valido'. SA endpoints return 403 for an org user and 401 for anonymous. Removing 'brevo' or moving ga4 to 'necessary' returns 400. Publish increments the version. Registry hides _id and created_at_dt and writes an audit log entry.
After publishing a new banner version, the banner reappears for a device whose stored versions are older.
SA UI: all 5 tabs render, the registry loads, and the 'Privacy e Cookie' sidebar item is present.
/cookie-policy shows services and version 2026.10.3, and cookie-policy-open-prefs opens the dialog. /privacy-policy and /privacy contain #google-calendar. /cookie renders. No 'Iubenda' text anywhere.
Mobile 390: banner fits (414-844px), all three buttons reachable (44px high), dialog scrolls, toggle and save work.
action_items: Fix 500 in PUT /api/platform/privacy/settings: catch the pydantic ValidationError and return 400/422 with a readable Italian message.

Fix the residual PostHog cookie after revocation: opt out, reset and switch to memory persistence before purging. Also purge analytics cookies at bootstrap when consent is false. Correct the condition on consent.js line 55 to check the analytics revocation.
Validate consent_id with uuid.UUID instead of the loose regex.
Make the registry table horizontally scrollable. Optionally use equal widths for the three banner buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html bootstrap (line 58) applies the stored consent when it is less than 180 days old but does not check versions. After a new version is published, GA/PostHog/Brevo still load with the previous consent while the banner is asked again. Consider deferring the trackers until a renewed choice if strict re-consent is wanted.
privacy_consent.settings(): insert_one(dict(DEFAULTS)) is a shallow copy and insert_one adds _id to the copy, not to DEFAULTS. OK, but the nested dicts are shared with DEFAULTS.
Rate limit of 20 records per consent_id per hour is easy to bypass by rotating ids. Acceptable for an MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 flows fully passing; revocation flow passes except the residual ph_ cookie)

seed_data_creation: Test org user test_privacy_*@example.com with org TEST_PrivacyOrg was created and then deleted by the fixture. Consent records were created by the testing devices (anonymous plus SA user_9b3dabbcca7e). Published versions with a TEST_ note: cookie 2026.10.1 -> 2026.10.3 (2 publishes), banner 2026.10.1 -> 2026.10.2. Current versions: privacy 2026.10.1, cookie 2026.10.3, banner 2026.10.2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter141_privacy_consent.py -n 0. Each run publishes a cookie version. The register-organization call needs telefono '+393331234567'. Preview host -> ga/brevo report 'allowed_host_skipped'. Use a fresh browser context per consent scenario. To check the ph cookie after revocation, read document.cookie after the reload.
rca of the issue: 500 on settings PUT: manual model construction outside FastAPI's request validation, so ValidationError propagates as an unhandled exception (confirmed in backend.err.log: 'ValidationError: 1 validation error for LangText text String should have at least 40 characters'). Residual PostHog cookie: purge() deletes cookies synchronously, then window.location.reload() is called while PostHog is still active, and PostHog persists its session cookie (on unload or a timer) before the page is torn down.
